From this fixture to a bicycle

This trial checks a real prismatic joint under tilted gravity and a transverse load, with a force-based spring motor. It is a first solver arm. The default release may exceed the fixed accuracy limits; a stable-looking replay is not an accuracy pass.

Still required: a matched second solver, hardtail/full-suspension assemblies, joint reactions, energy/work and contact checks, compliant stops, tyre/soil coupling and real-time measurements. Replay here is not a live riding simulation.
